Report translation keys no source code references. Nothing is deleted without --remove

## Synopsis

```bash
the-i18n-cli orphans
```

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--layer` | `string` | no | — | Filter to a specific layer |
| `--locale` | `string` | no | — | Locale to read keys from (default: project default) |
| `--remove` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Delete the orphan keys from every locale file. Uncertain and misplaced keys are never deleted |
| `--usages` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Report where keys are referenced in source (file paths and line numbers) instead of which are unreferenced |
| `--keys` | `string` | no | — | Comma-separated keys to report usages for (with --usages) |
| `--outputFile` | `string` | no | — | Write full output to this file path and return only a summary (useful for large outputs) |
| `--codequalityOutput` | `string` | no | — | Also write the orphan findings as a GitLab Code Quality (CodeClimate) JSON report to this file path |
| `--failOnOrphans` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Exit 2 when any orphan key is found (CI gate) |
